summary: Digimarc Corporation filed an 8-K reporting completion of its reorganization into a holding company structure (Digimarc Parent, Inc.) via merger, effectively creating a new public parent. Under the Reorganization Agreement dated March 12, 2026, shareholders approved the exchange of each share of Digimarc common stock for one share of Holdings common stock on a one-for-one basis, with no premium paid. The company then converted into an Oregon LLC (Digimarc LLC), delisting the original shares. Shareholder approval was obtained at the annual meeting on April 30, 2026. No financial advisor or break fee was disclosed. The resulting structure has no trading symbol for the LLC, effectively taking the operating entity private under Holdings. Watch for potential future transactions or liquidity events involving Holdings.
